identity_observations.finding: The 2016 annual report identifies Sears common stock as SHLD. This is an issuer observation, not an all-dates security mapping.
A separate ETF listed using SHLD in September 2023. Its prices cannot be assigned to Sears shares.
The 2022 annual report associates BBBY common stock with the original issuer; the CIK identifies the issuer, not every share class.
Beyond adopted BBBY effective 2025-08-29; this is a different issuer from the old BBBY company.
The old issuer renamed its shares TFCFA/TFCF during the 2019 separation while the new Fox traded as FOXA/FOX. A continuous FOXA ticker interval does not establish security continuity.
New Fox began standalone regular trading on 2019-03-19 following a share distribution. Source prices require separate security and distribution accounting.

The former Ingersoll-Rand plc became Trane Technologies and traded as TT on 2020-03-02; its industrial segment combined with Gardner Denver. A continuous IR interval spans a material identity transition.
The post-transaction IR issuer has CIK 0001699150, separate from the former Ingersoll-Rand plc filer. These CIK observations still do not certify raw share-class history.

The merger closed on 2017-07-25 while the index announcement specified deletion before 2017-07-26. Candidate history ends 2017-07-24; trading availability and index membership must be reconciled separately.

Issuer FAQ confirms trading ceased July 24, 2017 and merger completed before the July 25 open. The separately announced index deletion was July 26. Candidate end July 24 describes trading cessation, not the announced membership end. Entitlement is $29.44 cash plus ADSs representing 0.5260 BAT ordinary share per RAI share, with fractional net proceeds dependent on settlement. Full membership/settlement correction remains pending.

SEC Form 8-K reports November 7, 2024 plan effectiveness: pre-existing common equity was canceled with no distribution to common holders. This supports a terminal common-equity event, not a March 2023 zero-price assumption or complete intervening OTC history. Preferred interests had a different treatment.

transitions.identity: FOXA and FOX move from Twenty-First Century Fox Class A/B to new Fox Corporation Class A/B. Original residual shares trade as TFCFA/TFCF on March 19. Earlier News Corporation history remains unverified.
transitions.entitlements: Per original share, the March 19 distribution produces 1/3 new Fox share of the same class and 0.736817 residual Twenty-First Century Fox share. Fractional new Fox shares settle in cash. On March 20 each residual share has a merger election of $51.572626 cash OR 0.4517 Disney share, subject to proration and adjustment. Do not credit both alternatives.
transitions.membership: New Fox classes enter before the March 19 open; old Twenty-First Century Fox leaves before the March 20 open. Both issuers overlap in the index on March 19.

transitions.identity: Old Ingersoll-Rand plc continues as Trane Technologies (TT). Gardner Denver becomes the distinct new Ingersoll Rand (IR). A continuous IR price or membership series cannot identify both issuers. Earlier IR incorporations remain unverified.
transitions.entitlements: An entitled old Ingersoll-Rand shareholder retains the renamed Trane holding and receives 0.8824 new Ingersoll Rand shares per old share through the intermediate spin company merger. Do not replace the retained TT holding or also credit the intermediate spin share. Record date is February 24; distribution/merger is February 29. Fractional cash settlement remains unverified.
transitions.membership: TT continues old issuer membership with March 2 trading. The February 27 S&P announcement adds the new IR before the March 3 open, replacing XEC. Trading start and announced index entry are different dates; later amendments have not been comprehensively excluded.
blockers: Verify old IR-to-TT and Gardner Denver-to-new-IR raw price/security mappings independently.
Obtain fractional cash and account entitlements; record date alone does not resolve trades with distribution rights.
